text: 报告期内，光伏行业供需关系未有显著改善，企业经营持续承压。受新能源消纳不足及去年同期抢装高基数等多重因素影响，国内上半年新增光伏装机阶段性大幅回落。报告期内，公司组件销量和收入同比下降，开工率不足，毛利率较低，叠加联营企业投资损失及人民币升值带来的汇兑损失等影响，形成经营业绩亏损。 报告期内，面对行业经营困境，公司大力推进光伏业务全面BC化，持续丰富场景产品矩阵，海外市场销量和BC产品销量占比显著提升，BC技术提效降本举措持续落地，ACM（纳米合金矩阵式接触）电池实现规模化投产。
text_en: During the reporting period, the supply-demand relationship in the photovoltaic industry saw no significant improvement, and corporate operations continued to face pressure. Affected by multiple factors including insufficient new energy consumption and a high base from last year's rush installations, domestic new photovoltaic installed capacity saw a substantial phased decline in the first half of the year. During the reporting period, the company's module sales and revenue decreased year-on-year, with low capacity utilization rates and low gross margins. Combined with investment losses from associated enterprises and exchange losses from RMB appreciation, the company incurred operating losses. During the reporting period, facing industry operational difficulties, the company vigorously promoted the comprehensive BC transformation of its photovoltaic business, continuously enriched the scenario-based product matrix, and significantly increased overseas market sales and the proportion of BC product sales. BC technology efficiency improvement and cost reduction measures were continuously implemented, and ACM (Nano-alloy Matrix Contact) batteries achieved规模化 (large-scale) production.
